svg.title: An illustrative heading rewrite
svg.desc: An illustrative example rewrites the topic label Configuration as the task heading Configure the client with an API key, which names an action, an object, and a context. A table lists six section jobs with a generic label and an illustrative rewrite for each.
svg.text: Read it alone in the outline: the reader knows what they will have done.
